Battle Spirits - Kiseki no Hasha.name: Battle Spirits: Kiseki no Hasha
Battle Spirits - Kiseki no Hasha.summary: Battle Spirits Kiseki no Hasha was the first Battle Spirits video game, and the first to appear on the PSP console. It was released November 12th, 2009.

Blaze Union - Story to Reach the Future.name: Blaze Union: Story to Reach the Future
Blaze Union - Story to Reach the Future.summary: Blaze Union serves as the prequel to Yggdra Union, and shares the same systems with a few minor changes to gameplay. The most notable change is the addition of a mission selection system during two points of the game, which leads up to separate story branches much like a visual novel.

Metal Fight Beyblade Portable - Chouzets.name: Metal Fight Beyblade Portable: Chouzetsu Tensei! Vulcan Horuseus
Metal Fight Beyblade Portable - Chouzets.summary: Metal Fight Beyblade Portable: Chouzetsu Tensei Vulcan Horuseus is an Action game, developed by Amble and published by Takara Tomy, which was released in Japan in 2010.
